json.claim: Foot signs appear 'long before any blood test catches the problem' (diabetes)
json.source: NIDDK Diabetic Neuropathy https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/preventing-problems/nerve-damage-diabetic-neuropathies ; Baylor Medicine (neuropathy ~8-10 y after onset) https://www.bcm.edu/healthcare/specialties/neurology/neuromuscular-diseases/conditions/diabetic-neuropathy ; ADA Standards of Care 2026 screening (A1C/FPG from age 35) https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S6/163930/Summary-of-Revisions-Standards-of-Care-in-Diabetes
json.source_type: Government health agency + academic medical center + professional guideline
json.safe_reframing: Foot changes can appear in people who have had high blood sugar for years; an A1C blood test is how diabetes is actually found - usually years earlier than nerve damage.

json.claim: '9 Foot Signs of Hidden Diabetes' (title) - foot signs as diagnostic of hidden diabetes
json.appears_in: CJxCjygEnmo title; copied by >=6 external mills (C03)
json.source: NIDDK (neuropathy symptoms: numbness, tingling, burning; sores/ulcers from lost feeling) - these are complications seen IN diabetes, not validated diagnostic signs
json.safe_reframing: 'Foot changes that can come with long-term high blood sugar - and what to ask your doctor to test'.

json.claim: Clove + coffee: 'What happens 10 minutes later' / script: 'in the first 15 minutes... energy without the jitters... eugenol relaxes blood vessels'
json.source: Banner Health clove water review https://www.bannerhealth.com/healthcareblog/advise-me/the-benefits-and-risks-of-drinking-clove-water ; Noom evidence summary https://www.noom.com/blog/weight-management/clove-water-for-weight-loss/ (evidence is from concentrated extracts/preliminary studies, not culinary clove water)
json.safe_reframing: No study shows a 10- or 15-minute effect. Safe: 'What cloves actually contain, what the research on concentrated extracts shows, and why a cup of clove coffee is flavour, not medicine'. Note title (10 min) and script (15 min) disagree.

json.claim: 'Eugenol is a natural anti-inflammatory that works stronger than ibuprofen in some studies'
json.source: No human trial at culinary dose located this session; evidence summaries above describe lab/extract studies only
json.safe_reframing: Do not compare a spice to a drug. Say 'lab studies suggest eugenol has anti-inflammatory activity; that has not been shown in people drinking clove coffee'.

json.claim: Clove coffee: 'within 3 days blood sugar stabilizes... eugenol improves insulin receptor sensitivity'; 'within 1 month... cleaner liver'
json.source: Same evidence summaries (scarce human data)
json.safe_reframing: Remove dated benefit ladders. Blood-sugar claims require diabetes-care framing and a clinician referral.

json.claim: Clove/eugenol + blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin): talk to a doctor first
json.appears_in: KPigGh9_gbU transcript (contraindication segment); 1xLJ3ZsDt38 (SHH 'STOP using cloves with these medications')
json.source: Drugs.com clove-warfarin interaction https://www.drugs.com/drug-interactions/clove-with-warfarin-2548-0-2311-0.html ; PubMed alternative therapies & warfarin https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10902065/
json.safe_reframing: Keep: 'large amounts of clove, especially oil or extracts, may add to bleeding risk with blood thinners - ask your pharmacist'.

json.claim: 'Up to 12 kg of waste inside your body' / '5 KG of stool out in 1 hour' / 'Flush 10 lbs in 1 min' / '1 cup = total cleanse'
json.source: Mayo Clinic 'Colon cleansing: Is it helpful or harmful?' https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle/consumer-health/expert-answers/colon-cleansing/faq-20058435
json.safe_reframing: 'Constipation after 60: what actually helps (fiber, fluids, movement, medication review) and why colon cleanses are not recommended'.

json.claim: 'This fruit repairs eyes overnight - cataracts' (thumbnail)
json.source: American Academy of Ophthalmology nutrition review https://www.aao.org/eyenet/article/nutrition-in-fight-against-eye-disease ; NEI AREDS/AREDS2 https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/clinical-trials/age-related-eye-disease-studies-aredsareds2/about-areds-and-areds2 (AREDS supplements had no effect on cataract)
json.safe_reframing: 'Foods linked with eye health (leafy greens: lutein/zeaxanthin) - and what diet cannot do for cataracts'.

json.claim: 'This 1 vegetable heals dead kidneys (lower creatinine fast)' / 'lower creatinine overnight'
json.appears_in: Thumbnail #95 (Okoro), #63 (Ares); GT-14 rising 'how to lower creatinine overnight'
json.source: National Kidney Foundation creatinine https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/creatinine ; American Kidney Fund superfood trap https://www.kidneyfund.org/article/avoid-superfood-trap-tips-improve-your-creatinine-and-egfr
json.safe_reframing: 'What your creatinine number means, why no food heals kidneys overnight, and what actually protects kidney function (BP, sugar control, medication review)'.

json.claim: 'This sleeping position increases STROKE risk overnight'
json.source: American Heart Association 'Can sleep position affect your heart and brain health?' https://www.heart.org/en/news/2025/01/24/can-sleep-position-affect-your-heart-and-brain-health
json.safe_reframing: 'Back-sleeping can worsen sleep apnea - and untreated sleep apnea raises stroke risk'. No evidence that position alone causes stroke in healthy people.

json.claim: 'The most dangerous time to take blood pressure medication' / 'NEVER take BP pills at this time'
json.source: TIME trial, Lancet 2022 https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(22)01786-X/fulltext (evening vs morning: no difference in major CV outcomes; take at a convenient consistent time)
json.safe_reframing: 'Morning or night for BP pills? The 21,000-person TIME trial found no difference - consistency and side-effect timing matter more'.

json.claim: 'One of them could drop your blood pressure so fast you'll hit the floor before you reach the bathroom'
json.source: JAMDA meta-analysis orthostatic hypotension and falls https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(18)30635-2/abstract ; AHA Hypertension class-effects study https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/hypertensionaha.119.13445 (no long-term class difference in falls/syncope)
json.safe_reframing: Orthostatic dizziness is real and linked to falls; say 'stand up slowly, report dizziness', not 'this pill will make you hit the floor'.

json.claim: '9 popular medications that can trigger RAPID dementia' / 'medications that cause dementia'
json.source: AGS Beers Criteria (anticholinergic burden -> cognitive decline, delirium, falls) https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/24946-beers-criteria
json.safe_reframing: 'Medicines on the Beers list that can affect memory in older adults - review them with your pharmacist' (drop 'rapid dementia').

json.claim: Exercise/balance training prevents falls
json.source: Cochrane review Sherrington 2019 https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD012424.pub2/full (exercise reduces rate of falls 23%, high certainty); CDC falls facts https://www.cdc.gov/falls/data-research/facts-stats/index.html
json.safe_reframing: Keep. Frame a single walking cue as one part of balance training, not a life-saving guarantee.

json.claim: 'One SIMPLE change to how you walk could save your life after 70'
json.source: Cochrane 2019 supports multi-component exercise programs, not one gait cue
json.safe_reframing: 'The walking habit physical therapists check first - and the balance exercises proven to cut falls'.

json.claim: 'The ONLY 6 exercises you need to relieve neuropathy in feet & legs'
json.source: PMC meta-analysis exercise in DPN https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10065320/ (balance improved; no clear effect on fall risk); BMC Neuroscience RCT https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12868-024-00924-6
json.safe_reframing: 'Seated exercises that can improve balance and symptom comfort with neuropathy' - drop 'only' and 'relieve' as a cure promise.

json.claim: 'The REAL reason you wake up to pee at night - it's not your bladder'
json.source: Sleep Foundation nocturia https://www.sleepfoundation.org/physical-health/nocturia-or-frequent-unrination-night (nocturnal polyuria may be the most common cause; evening fluid/caffeine limits advised)
json.source_type: Health information publisher citing clinical literature
json.safe_reframing: 'Often it's how much urine your body makes at night, not bladder size - and when to get checked (prostate, diabetes, heart, sleep apnea)'.

json.claim: Seniors need to bathe only 2-3 times per week; short warm showers
json.source: American Academy of Dermatology guidance as reported by StudyFinds https://studyfinds.com/how-often-should-seniors-shower-experts-say-daily-too-much/ and Medical News Today https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/324682 (secondary sources)
json.safe_reframing: 'Most older adults don't need a full bath daily - dry skin is the reason; daily washing of key areas still matters'.

json.claim: 'Stanford study: wall-assisted mini squat cut knee pain 64% in 137 adults aged 70-88'; 'Johns Hopkins 2022, 1,100 adults'
json.source: Search for the cited Stanford trial found no matching study (closest: Saudi Arabia isometric wall-squat RCT https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41381113/)
json.safe_reframing: Never cite a study that cannot be linked. Use Cochrane/RCT sources with URLs in the description.

json.claim: 'Add THIS to your coffee - stem cells reactivate, cancer starves, fat burns'
json.appears_in: 1KEvPjIZVsU (Elias 1.3K); HWP 'This ONE Food Regrows Stem Cells & STARVES Cancer'
json.source: No supporting human evidence found; extraordinary cancer claim
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE.

json.claim: 'World's No.1 heart surgeon: Walking won't save you / STOP WALKING'
json.source: CDC falls/physical-activity guidance; Cochrane 2019 (walking-inclusive exercise programs)
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE. Acceptable contrarian: 'walking alone may not build leg strength - add these strength moves' (TopHealthTips 800K shows the accurate version works).

json.claim: 'Never eat this fish - it shortens your life' (salmon shown)
json.source: American Heart Association fish twice weekly https://www.heart.org/en/news/2018/05/25/eating-fish-twice-a-week-reduces-heart-stroke-risk
json.safe_reframing: 'Which fish to limit (high-mercury) vs which to eat twice a week' - never show salmon as the villain.

json.claim: Supplement-drug interactions (e.g., turmeric with statins/BP tablets)
json.source: Clove-warfarin interaction evidence (MV-06) as model; turmeric-specific source not fetched this session
json.safe_reframing: 'Supplements to check with your pharmacist if you take blood thinners, statins or BP tablets'.

json.claim: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy pill) availability for older adults
json.source: Novo Nordisk FDA approval announcement (Dec 22, 2025) https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=916472 ; AJMC https://www.ajmc.com/view/fda-approves-oral-semaglutide-as-first-glp-1-pill-for-weight-loss
json.source_type: Manufacturer + trade press on FDA action
json.safe_reframing: Only factual status + 'questions to ask your doctor'; no dosing advice.

lessons.full_bleed_workflow: Full-bleed: prep_full.sh -> bands.json add auto_fill + depth_label -> author_review.py via author_lib (stage [0,1]); measure camera with rows e.g. 0.05:0.55, colour blink with measure_color_area.py; unquoted loop vars do not split in zsh (use ${=args})
lessons.fill_small: Author.fill_small(172) adds UNRESOLVED_CHANGE rows for detected changes >=172 stage px that no authored event covers; call it just before A.write() in full-bleed videos with many small events (ud1ESmogrFY)
lessons.aggregate_audio: scripts/aggregate_audio.py computes the audio table (voiced %, wpm, phrase rate, pauses, levels, flux at cuts, cut-to-word offsets) over all validated videos into evidence/audio_aggregate.json
lessons.full_mode_qa: In full mode QA does not require every small (<0.8 %) change to be attributed: A.fill_small is optional there; a cut-like event placed on a frame with 0 stage px (e.g. a removal one frame earlier) fails every_hard_cut_has_large_stage_change, so confirm the frame from the px series
lessons.dash_ids: Video ids starting with '-' (-WJDfT-MwmY, -Vr8JhCIv08): argparse scripts (event_sheets.py, make_sheet.py) need options first and `-- <vid> <root>`; build_video_tables.py, write_review.py and measure_*.py take positionals and must NOT get `--`; measure_motion.py/measure_color_area.py take rows and segments as bare args (`0.0:0.5`, `640:722,1270:1312`), not `rows=...`
lessons.stale_caption_files: If prep_banded.sh was run to peek at a layout and the video is then analysed in full mode, delete videos/<id>/auto/CAPTION_EVENTS_AUTO.csv and CAPTION_WORD_EVENTS.csv before build_video_tables.py, otherwise caption offsets are computed from a band that does not exist (m8NC4L8hmeE, fixed 2026-10-20)
lessons.fill_small_cut_duplicates: A.fill_small(172) also adds UNRESOLVED rows for cut frames that build_video_tables later turns into HARD_CUT_REPLACE; drop UNRESOLVED rows whose text mentions CUT/BIG_POP and that sit within 2 frames of a scene start (see videos/m8NC4L8hmeE/review/author_review.py), otherwise events and the unresolved share are inflated
lessons.coverage_gaps: QA fails if any stage-active frame (>=172 px) is outside every authored event: slow slides, continuous character loops (~500-1200 px per frame for dozens of frames), slow drifts (bbox moves 0.05 of frame height over ~146 frames) and typed-caption starts need an event spanning those frames
lessons.clip_cadence: Third-party clip inserts update every 3rd frame (10 fps) on 30 fps files (alternating 2/3 on 24 fps); measure by mean abs diff inside the clip region and list update frames; op VIDEO_CLIP_INSERT (mclass INDET) was added to build_video_tables.py TAX
lessons.tracker_limits: measure_motion camera saturates for fast zooms (per-frame scale cap ~1.03) and returns net 0 px when a chart line reveals while the page moves: report such moves as DIRECTLY_OBSERVED without geometry
lessons.read_along_pans: measure_motion.py camera on a text page returns per-frame dx_px; run-length encode curves[].dx_px to get constant-velocity passes and returns (2EZzwupIa80); its scale_fit/pan_*_fit are meaningless when net scale is ~1.0 or the page repeats
lessons.small_stage_layout: layout_profile can show activity only in rows 0.37-0.72 with cuts(>=20%)=0 (JsK53moCyZA): use full mode, hard cuts are changes of 6-31 % of the band; build_video_tables accepts them (>=1000 px)
lessons.caption_lead_frame: At some cuts the caption block clears one frame before the picture; check px(f-1) at each hard cut and log a CAPTION_CHUNK_CHANGE in the previous scene

LF-3 sampling plan (write it to videos/<id>/review/WINDOWS.json BEFORE looking at content): first 60 s, last 60 s, plus N 45-s windows by fixed seed: top-20 % and bottom-20 % event density and 3 random. Record seed and window-seconds / total-seconds.

json.claim: Foot signs appear 'long before any blood test catches the problem' (diabetes)
json.source: NIDDK Diabetic Neuropathy https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/preventing-problems/nerve-damage-diabetic-neuropathies ; Baylor Medicine (neuropathy ~8-10 y after onset) https://www.bcm.edu/healthcare/specialties/neurology/neuromuscular-diseases/conditions/diabetic-neuropathy ; ADA Standards of Care 2026 screening (A1C/FPG from age 35) https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S6/163930/Summary-of-Revisions-Standards-of-Care-in-Diabetes
json.source_type: Government health agency + academic medical center + professional guideline
json.safe_reframing: Foot changes can appear in people who have had high blood sugar for years; an A1C blood test is how diabetes is actually found - usually years earlier than nerve damage.

json.claim: '9 Foot Signs of Hidden Diabetes' (title) - foot signs as diagnostic of hidden diabetes
json.appears_in: CJxCjygEnmo title; copied by >=6 external mills (C03)
json.source: NIDDK (neuropathy symptoms: numbness, tingling, burning; sores/ulcers from lost feeling) - these are complications seen IN diabetes, not validated diagnostic signs
json.safe_reframing: 'Foot changes that can come with long-term high blood sugar - and what to ask your doctor to test'.

json.claim: Clove + coffee: 'What happens 10 minutes later' / script: 'in the first 15 minutes... energy without the jitters... eugenol relaxes blood vessels'
json.source: Banner Health clove water review https://www.bannerhealth.com/healthcareblog/advise-me/the-benefits-and-risks-of-drinking-clove-water ; Noom evidence summary https://www.noom.com/blog/weight-management/clove-water-for-weight-loss/ (evidence is from concentrated extracts/preliminary studies, not culinary clove water)
json.safe_reframing: No study shows a 10- or 15-minute effect. Safe: 'What cloves actually contain, what the research on concentrated extracts shows, and why a cup of clove coffee is flavour, not medicine'. Note title (10 min) and script (15 min) disagree.

json.claim: 'Eugenol is a natural anti-inflammatory that works stronger than ibuprofen in some studies'
json.source: No human trial at culinary dose located this session; evidence summaries above describe lab/extract studies only
json.safe_reframing: Do not compare a spice to a drug. Say 'lab studies suggest eugenol has anti-inflammatory activity; that has not been shown in people drinking clove coffee'.

json.claim: Clove coffee: 'within 3 days blood sugar stabilizes... eugenol improves insulin receptor sensitivity'; 'within 1 month... cleaner liver'
json.source: Same evidence summaries (scarce human data)
json.safe_reframing: Remove dated benefit ladders. Blood-sugar claims require diabetes-care framing and a clinician referral.

json.claim: Clove/eugenol + blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin): talk to a doctor first
json.appears_in: KPigGh9_gbU transcript (contraindication segment); 1xLJ3ZsDt38 (SHH 'STOP using cloves with these medications')
json.source: Drugs.com clove-warfarin interaction https://www.drugs.com/drug-interactions/clove-with-warfarin-2548-0-2311-0.html ; PubMed alternative therapies & warfarin https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10902065/
json.safe_reframing: Keep: 'large amounts of clove, especially oil or extracts, may add to bleeding risk with blood thinners - ask your pharmacist'.

json.claim: 'Up to 12 kg of waste inside your body' / '5 KG of stool out in 1 hour' / 'Flush 10 lbs in 1 min' / '1 cup = total cleanse'
json.source: Mayo Clinic 'Colon cleansing: Is it helpful or harmful?' https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle/consumer-health/expert-answers/colon-cleansing/faq-20058435
json.safe_reframing: 'Constipation after 60: what actually helps (fiber, fluids, movement, medication review) and why colon cleanses are not recommended'.

json.claim: 'This fruit repairs eyes overnight - cataracts' (thumbnail)
json.source: American Academy of Ophthalmology nutrition review https://www.aao.org/eyenet/article/nutrition-in-fight-against-eye-disease ; NEI AREDS/AREDS2 https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/clinical-trials/age-related-eye-disease-studies-aredsareds2/about-areds-and-areds2 (AREDS supplements had no effect on cataract)
json.safe_reframing: 'Foods linked with eye health (leafy greens: lutein/zeaxanthin) - and what diet cannot do for cataracts'.

json.claim: 'This 1 vegetable heals dead kidneys (lower creatinine fast)' / 'lower creatinine overnight'
json.appears_in: Thumbnail #95 (Okoro), #63 (Ares); GT-14 rising 'how to lower creatinine overnight'
json.source: National Kidney Foundation creatinine https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/creatinine ; American Kidney Fund superfood trap https://www.kidneyfund.org/article/avoid-superfood-trap-tips-improve-your-creatinine-and-egfr
json.safe_reframing: 'What your creatinine number means, why no food heals kidneys overnight, and what actually protects kidney function (BP, sugar control, medication review)'.

json.claim: 'This sleeping position increases STROKE risk overnight'
json.source: American Heart Association 'Can sleep position affect your heart and brain health?' https://www.heart.org/en/news/2025/01/24/can-sleep-position-affect-your-heart-and-brain-health
json.safe_reframing: 'Back-sleeping can worsen sleep apnea - and untreated sleep apnea raises stroke risk'. No evidence that position alone causes stroke in healthy people.

json.claim: 'The most dangerous time to take blood pressure medication' / 'NEVER take BP pills at this time'
json.source: TIME trial, Lancet 2022 https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(22)01786-X/fulltext (evening vs morning: no difference in major CV outcomes; take at a convenient consistent time)
json.safe_reframing: 'Morning or night for BP pills? The 21,000-person TIME trial found no difference - consistency and side-effect timing matter more'.

json.claim: 'One of them could drop your blood pressure so fast you'll hit the floor before you reach the bathroom'
json.source: JAMDA meta-analysis orthostatic hypotension and falls https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(18)30635-2/abstract ; AHA Hypertension class-effects study https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/hypertensionaha.119.13445 (no long-term class difference in falls/syncope)
json.safe_reframing: Orthostatic dizziness is real and linked to falls; say 'stand up slowly, report dizziness', not 'this pill will make you hit the floor'.

json.claim: '9 popular medications that can trigger RAPID dementia' / 'medications that cause dementia'
json.source: AGS Beers Criteria (anticholinergic burden -> cognitive decline, delirium, falls) https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/24946-beers-criteria
json.safe_reframing: 'Medicines on the Beers list that can affect memory in older adults - review them with your pharmacist' (drop 'rapid dementia').

json.claim: Exercise/balance training prevents falls
json.source: Cochrane review Sherrington 2019 https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD012424.pub2/full (exercise reduces rate of falls 23%, high certainty); CDC falls facts https://www.cdc.gov/falls/data-research/facts-stats/index.html
json.safe_reframing: Keep. Frame a single walking cue as one part of balance training, not a life-saving guarantee.

json.claim: 'One SIMPLE change to how you walk could save your life after 70'
json.source: Cochrane 2019 supports multi-component exercise programs, not one gait cue
json.safe_reframing: 'The walking habit physical therapists check first - and the balance exercises proven to cut falls'.

json.claim: 'The ONLY 6 exercises you need to relieve neuropathy in feet & legs'
json.source: PMC meta-analysis exercise in DPN https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10065320/ (balance improved; no clear effect on fall risk); BMC Neuroscience RCT https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12868-024-00924-6
json.safe_reframing: 'Seated exercises that can improve balance and symptom comfort with neuropathy' - drop 'only' and 'relieve' as a cure promise.

json.claim: 'The REAL reason you wake up to pee at night - it's not your bladder'
json.source: Sleep Foundation nocturia https://www.sleepfoundation.org/physical-health/nocturia-or-frequent-unrination-night (nocturnal polyuria may be the most common cause; evening fluid/caffeine limits advised)
json.source_type: Health information publisher citing clinical literature
json.safe_reframing: 'Often it's how much urine your body makes at night, not bladder size - and when to get checked (prostate, diabetes, heart, sleep apnea)'.

json.claim: Seniors need to bathe only 2-3 times per week; short warm showers
json.source: American Academy of Dermatology guidance as reported by StudyFinds https://studyfinds.com/how-often-should-seniors-shower-experts-say-daily-too-much/ and Medical News Today https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/324682 (secondary sources)
json.safe_reframing: 'Most older adults don't need a full bath daily - dry skin is the reason; daily washing of key areas still matters'.

json.claim: 'Stanford study: wall-assisted mini squat cut knee pain 64% in 137 adults aged 70-88'; 'Johns Hopkins 2022, 1,100 adults'
json.source: Search for the cited Stanford trial found no matching study (closest: Saudi Arabia isometric wall-squat RCT https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41381113/)
json.safe_reframing: Never cite a study that cannot be linked. Use Cochrane/RCT sources with URLs in the description.

json.claim: 'Add THIS to your coffee - stem cells reactivate, cancer starves, fat burns'
json.appears_in: 1KEvPjIZVsU (Elias 1.3K); HWP 'This ONE Food Regrows Stem Cells & STARVES Cancer'
json.source: No supporting human evidence found; extraordinary cancer claim
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE.

json.claim: 'World's No.1 heart surgeon: Walking won't save you / STOP WALKING'
json.source: CDC falls/physical-activity guidance; Cochrane 2019 (walking-inclusive exercise programs)
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE. Acceptable contrarian: 'walking alone may not build leg strength - add these strength moves' (TopHealthTips 800K shows the accurate version works).

json.claim: 'Never eat this fish - it shortens your life' (salmon shown)
json.source: American Heart Association fish twice weekly https://www.heart.org/en/news/2018/05/25/eating-fish-twice-a-week-reduces-heart-stroke-risk
json.safe_reframing: 'Which fish to limit (high-mercury) vs which to eat twice a week' - never show salmon as the villain.

json.claim: Supplement-drug interactions (e.g., turmeric with statins/BP tablets)
json.source: Clove-warfarin interaction evidence (MV-06) as model; turmeric-specific source not fetched this session
json.safe_reframing: 'Supplements to check with your pharmacist if you take blood thinners, statins or BP tablets'.

json.claim: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy pill) availability for older adults
json.source: Novo Nordisk FDA approval announcement (Dec 22, 2025) https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=916472 ; AJMC https://www.ajmc.com/view/fda-approves-oral-semaglutide-as-first-glp-1-pill-for-weight-loss
json.source_type: Manufacturer + trade press on FDA action
json.safe_reframing: Only factual status + 'questions to ask your doctor'; no dosing advice.

json.claim: Foot signs appear 'long before any blood test catches the problem' (diabetes)
json.source: NIDDK Diabetic Neuropathy https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/preventing-problems/nerve-damage-diabetic-neuropathies ; Baylor Medicine (neuropathy ~8-10 y after onset) https://www.bcm.edu/healthcare/specialties/neurology/neuromuscular-diseases/conditions/diabetic-neuropathy ; ADA Standards of Care 2026 screening (A1C/FPG from age 35) https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S6/163930/Summary-of-Revisions-Standards-of-Care-in-Diabetes
json.source_type: Government health agency + academic medical center + professional guideline
json.safe_reframing: Foot changes can appear in people who have had high blood sugar for years; an A1C blood test is how diabetes is actually found - usually years earlier than nerve damage.

json.claim: '9 Foot Signs of Hidden Diabetes' (title) - foot signs as diagnostic of hidden diabetes
json.appears_in: CJxCjygEnmo title; copied by >=6 external mills (C03)
json.source: NIDDK (neuropathy symptoms: numbness, tingling, burning; sores/ulcers from lost feeling) - these are complications seen IN diabetes, not validated diagnostic signs
json.safe_reframing: 'Foot changes that can come with long-term high blood sugar - and what to ask your doctor to test'.

json.claim: Clove + coffee: 'What happens 10 minutes later' / script: 'in the first 15 minutes... energy without the jitters... eugenol relaxes blood vessels'
json.source: Banner Health clove water review https://www.bannerhealth.com/healthcareblog/advise-me/the-benefits-and-risks-of-drinking-clove-water ; Noom evidence summary https://www.noom.com/blog/weight-management/clove-water-for-weight-loss/ (evidence is from concentrated extracts/preliminary studies, not culinary clove water)
json.safe_reframing: No study shows a 10- or 15-minute effect. Safe: 'What cloves actually contain, what the research on concentrated extracts shows, and why a cup of clove coffee is flavour, not medicine'. Note title (10 min) and script (15 min) disagree.

json.claim: 'Eugenol is a natural anti-inflammatory that works stronger than ibuprofen in some studies'
json.source: No human trial at culinary dose located this session; evidence summaries above describe lab/extract studies only
json.safe_reframing: Do not compare a spice to a drug. Say 'lab studies suggest eugenol has anti-inflammatory activity; that has not been shown in people drinking clove coffee'.

json.claim: Clove coffee: 'within 3 days blood sugar stabilizes... eugenol improves insulin receptor sensitivity'; 'within 1 month... cleaner liver'
json.source: Same evidence summaries (scarce human data)
json.safe_reframing: Remove dated benefit ladders. Blood-sugar claims require diabetes-care framing and a clinician referral.

json.claim: Clove/eugenol + blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin): talk to a doctor first
json.appears_in: KPigGh9_gbU transcript (contraindication segment); 1xLJ3ZsDt38 (SHH 'STOP using cloves with these medications')
json.source: Drugs.com clove-warfarin interaction https://www.drugs.com/drug-interactions/clove-with-warfarin-2548-0-2311-0.html ; PubMed alternative therapies & warfarin https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10902065/
json.safe_reframing: Keep: 'large amounts of clove, especially oil or extracts, may add to bleeding risk with blood thinners - ask your pharmacist'.

json.claim: 'Up to 12 kg of waste inside your body' / '5 KG of stool out in 1 hour' / 'Flush 10 lbs in 1 min' / '1 cup = total cleanse'
json.source: Mayo Clinic 'Colon cleansing: Is it helpful or harmful?' https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle/consumer-health/expert-answers/colon-cleansing/faq-20058435
json.safe_reframing: 'Constipation after 60: what actually helps (fiber, fluids, movement, medication review) and why colon cleanses are not recommended'.

json.claim: 'This fruit repairs eyes overnight - cataracts' (thumbnail)
json.source: American Academy of Ophthalmology nutrition review https://www.aao.org/eyenet/article/nutrition-in-fight-against-eye-disease ; NEI AREDS/AREDS2 https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/clinical-trials/age-related-eye-disease-studies-aredsareds2/about-areds-and-areds2 (AREDS supplements had no effect on cataract)
json.safe_reframing: 'Foods linked with eye health (leafy greens: lutein/zeaxanthin) - and what diet cannot do for cataracts'.

json.claim: 'This 1 vegetable heals dead kidneys (lower creatinine fast)' / 'lower creatinine overnight'
json.appears_in: Thumbnail #95 (Okoro), #63 (Ares); GT-14 rising 'how to lower creatinine overnight'
json.source: National Kidney Foundation creatinine https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/creatinine ; American Kidney Fund superfood trap https://www.kidneyfund.org/article/avoid-superfood-trap-tips-improve-your-creatinine-and-egfr
json.safe_reframing: 'What your creatinine number means, why no food heals kidneys overnight, and what actually protects kidney function (BP, sugar control, medication review)'.

json.claim: 'This sleeping position increases STROKE risk overnight'
json.source: American Heart Association 'Can sleep position affect your heart and brain health?' https://www.heart.org/en/news/2025/01/24/can-sleep-position-affect-your-heart-and-brain-health
json.safe_reframing: 'Back-sleeping can worsen sleep apnea - and untreated sleep apnea raises stroke risk'. No evidence that position alone causes stroke in healthy people.

json.claim: 'The most dangerous time to take blood pressure medication' / 'NEVER take BP pills at this time'
json.source: TIME trial, Lancet 2022 https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(22)01786-X/fulltext (evening vs morning: no difference in major CV outcomes; take at a convenient consistent time)
json.safe_reframing: 'Morning or night for BP pills? The 21,000-person TIME trial found no difference - consistency and side-effect timing matter more'.

json.claim: 'One of them could drop your blood pressure so fast you'll hit the floor before you reach the bathroom'
json.source: JAMDA meta-analysis orthostatic hypotension and falls https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(18)30635-2/abstract ; AHA Hypertension class-effects study https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/hypertensionaha.119.13445 (no long-term class difference in falls/syncope)
json.safe_reframing: Orthostatic dizziness is real and linked to falls; say 'stand up slowly, report dizziness', not 'this pill will make you hit the floor'.

json.claim: '9 popular medications that can trigger RAPID dementia' / 'medications that cause dementia'
json.source: AGS Beers Criteria (anticholinergic burden -> cognitive decline, delirium, falls) https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/24946-beers-criteria
json.safe_reframing: 'Medicines on the Beers list that can affect memory in older adults - review them with your pharmacist' (drop 'rapid dementia').

json.claim: Exercise/balance training prevents falls
json.source: Cochrane review Sherrington 2019 https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD012424.pub2/full (exercise reduces rate of falls 23%, high certainty); CDC falls facts https://www.cdc.gov/falls/data-research/facts-stats/index.html
json.safe_reframing: Keep. Frame a single walking cue as one part of balance training, not a life-saving guarantee.

json.claim: 'One SIMPLE change to how you walk could save your life after 70'
json.source: Cochrane 2019 supports multi-component exercise programs, not one gait cue
json.safe_reframing: 'The walking habit physical therapists check first - and the balance exercises proven to cut falls'.

json.claim: 'The ONLY 6 exercises you need to relieve neuropathy in feet & legs'
json.source: PMC meta-analysis exercise in DPN https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10065320/ (balance improved; no clear effect on fall risk); BMC Neuroscience RCT https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12868-024-00924-6
json.safe_reframing: 'Seated exercises that can improve balance and symptom comfort with neuropathy' - drop 'only' and 'relieve' as a cure promise.

json.claim: 'The REAL reason you wake up to pee at night - it's not your bladder'
json.source: Sleep Foundation nocturia https://www.sleepfoundation.org/physical-health/nocturia-or-frequent-unrination-night (nocturnal polyuria may be the most common cause; evening fluid/caffeine limits advised)
json.source_type: Health information publisher citing clinical literature
json.safe_reframing: 'Often it's how much urine your body makes at night, not bladder size - and when to get checked (prostate, diabetes, heart, sleep apnea)'.

json.claim: Seniors need to bathe only 2-3 times per week; short warm showers
json.source: American Academy of Dermatology guidance as reported by StudyFinds https://studyfinds.com/how-often-should-seniors-shower-experts-say-daily-too-much/ and Medical News Today https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/324682 (secondary sources)
json.safe_reframing: 'Most older adults don't need a full bath daily - dry skin is the reason; daily washing of key areas still matters'.

json.claim: 'Stanford study: wall-assisted mini squat cut knee pain 64% in 137 adults aged 70-88'; 'Johns Hopkins 2022, 1,100 adults'
json.source: Search for the cited Stanford trial found no matching study (closest: Saudi Arabia isometric wall-squat RCT https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41381113/)
json.safe_reframing: Never cite a study that cannot be linked. Use Cochrane/RCT sources with URLs in the description.

json.claim: 'Add THIS to your coffee - stem cells reactivate, cancer starves, fat burns'
json.appears_in: 1KEvPjIZVsU (Elias 1.3K); HWP 'This ONE Food Regrows Stem Cells & STARVES Cancer'
json.source: No supporting human evidence found; extraordinary cancer claim
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE.

json.claim: 'World's No.1 heart surgeon: Walking won't save you / STOP WALKING'
json.source: CDC falls/physical-activity guidance; Cochrane 2019 (walking-inclusive exercise programs)
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE. Acceptable contrarian: 'walking alone may not build leg strength - add these strength moves' (TopHealthTips 800K shows the accurate version works).

json.claim: 'Never eat this fish - it shortens your life' (salmon shown)
json.source: American Heart Association fish twice weekly https://www.heart.org/en/news/2018/05/25/eating-fish-twice-a-week-reduces-heart-stroke-risk
json.safe_reframing: 'Which fish to limit (high-mercury) vs which to eat twice a week' - never show salmon as the villain.

json.claim: Supplement-drug interactions (e.g., turmeric with statins/BP tablets)
json.source: Clove-warfarin interaction evidence (MV-06) as model; turmeric-specific source not fetched this session
json.safe_reframing: 'Supplements to check with your pharmacist if you take blood thinners, statins or BP tablets'.

json.claim: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy pill) availability for older adults
json.source: Novo Nordisk FDA approval announcement (Dec 22, 2025) https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=916472 ; AJMC https://www.ajmc.com/view/fda-approves-oral-semaglutide-as-first-glp-1-pill-for-weight-loss

json.claim: Foot signs appear 'long before any blood test catches the problem' (diabetes)
json.source: NIDDK Diabetic Neuropathy https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/preventing-problems/nerve-damage-diabetic-neuropathies ; Baylor Medicine (neuropathy ~8-10 y after onset) https://www.bcm.edu/healthcare/specialties/neurology/neuromuscular-diseases/conditions/diabetic-neuropathy ; ADA Standards of Care 2026 screening (A1C/FPG from age 35) https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S6/163930/Summary-of-Revisions-Standards-of-Care-in-Diabetes
json.source_type: Government health agency + academic medical center + professional guideline
json.safe_reframing: Foot changes can appear in people who have had high blood sugar for years; an A1C blood test is how diabetes is actually found - usually years earlier than nerve damage.

json.claim: '9 Foot Signs of Hidden Diabetes' (title) - foot signs as diagnostic of hidden diabetes
json.appears_in: CJxCjygEnmo title; copied by >=6 external mills (C03)
json.source: NIDDK (neuropathy symptoms: numbness, tingling, burning; sores/ulcers from lost feeling) - these are complications seen IN diabetes, not validated diagnostic signs
json.safe_reframing: 'Foot changes that can come with long-term high blood sugar - and what to ask your doctor to test'.

json.claim: Clove + coffee: 'What happens 10 minutes later' / script: 'in the first 15 minutes... energy without the jitters... eugenol relaxes blood vessels'
json.source: Banner Health clove water review https://www.bannerhealth.com/healthcareblog/advise-me/the-benefits-and-risks-of-drinking-clove-water ; Noom evidence summary https://www.noom.com/blog/weight-management/clove-water-for-weight-loss/ (evidence is from concentrated extracts/preliminary studies, not culinary clove water)
json.safe_reframing: No study shows a 10- or 15-minute effect. Safe: 'What cloves actually contain, what the research on concentrated extracts shows, and why a cup of clove coffee is flavour, not medicine'. Note title (10 min) and script (15 min) disagree.

json.claim: 'Eugenol is a natural anti-inflammatory that works stronger than ibuprofen in some studies'
json.source: No human trial at culinary dose located this session; evidence summaries above describe lab/extract studies only
json.safe_reframing: Do not compare a spice to a drug. Say 'lab studies suggest eugenol has anti-inflammatory activity; that has not been shown in people drinking clove coffee'.

json.claim: Clove coffee: 'within 3 days blood sugar stabilizes... eugenol improves insulin receptor sensitivity'; 'within 1 month... cleaner liver'
json.source: Same evidence summaries (scarce human data)
json.safe_reframing: Remove dated benefit ladders. Blood-sugar claims require diabetes-care framing and a clinician referral.

json.claim: Clove/eugenol + blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin): talk to a doctor first
json.appears_in: KPigGh9_gbU transcript (contraindication segment); 1xLJ3ZsDt38 (SHH 'STOP using cloves with these medications')
json.source: Drugs.com clove-warfarin interaction https://www.drugs.com/drug-interactions/clove-with-warfarin-2548-0-2311-0.html ; PubMed alternative therapies & warfarin https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10902065/
json.safe_reframing: Keep: 'large amounts of clove, especially oil or extracts, may add to bleeding risk with blood thinners - ask your pharmacist'.

json.claim: 'Up to 12 kg of waste inside your body' / '5 KG of stool out in 1 hour' / 'Flush 10 lbs in 1 min' / '1 cup = total cleanse'
json.source: Mayo Clinic 'Colon cleansing: Is it helpful or harmful?' https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle/consumer-health/expert-answers/colon-cleansing/faq-20058435
json.safe_reframing: 'Constipation after 60: what actually helps (fiber, fluids, movement, medication review) and why colon cleanses are not recommended'.

json.claim: 'This fruit repairs eyes overnight - cataracts' (thumbnail)
json.source: American Academy of Ophthalmology nutrition review https://www.aao.org/eyenet/article/nutrition-in-fight-against-eye-disease ; NEI AREDS/AREDS2 https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/clinical-trials/age-related-eye-disease-studies-aredsareds2/about-areds-and-areds2 (AREDS supplements had no effect on cataract)
json.safe_reframing: 'Foods linked with eye health (leafy greens: lutein/zeaxanthin) - and what diet cannot do for cataracts'.

json.claim: 'This 1 vegetable heals dead kidneys (lower creatinine fast)' / 'lower creatinine overnight'
json.appears_in: Thumbnail #95 (Okoro), #63 (Ares); GT-14 rising 'how to lower creatinine overnight'
json.source: National Kidney Foundation creatinine https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/creatinine ; American Kidney Fund superfood trap https://www.kidneyfund.org/article/avoid-superfood-trap-tips-improve-your-creatinine-and-egfr
json.safe_reframing: 'What your creatinine number means, why no food heals kidneys overnight, and what actually protects kidney function (BP, sugar control, medication review)'.

json.claim: 'This sleeping position increases STROKE risk overnight'
json.source: American Heart Association 'Can sleep position affect your heart and brain health?' https://www.heart.org/en/news/2025/01/24/can-sleep-position-affect-your-heart-and-brain-health
json.safe_reframing: 'Back-sleeping can worsen sleep apnea - and untreated sleep apnea raises stroke risk'. No evidence that position alone causes stroke in healthy people.

json.claim: 'The most dangerous time to take blood pressure medication' / 'NEVER take BP pills at this time'
json.source: TIME trial, Lancet 2022 https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(22)01786-X/fulltext (evening vs morning: no difference in major CV outcomes; take at a convenient consistent time)
json.safe_reframing: 'Morning or night for BP pills? The 21,000-person TIME trial found no difference - consistency and side-effect timing matter more'.

json.claim: 'One of them could drop your blood pressure so fast you'll hit the floor before you reach the bathroom'
json.source: JAMDA meta-analysis orthostatic hypotension and falls https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(18)30635-2/abstract ; AHA Hypertension class-effects study https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/hypertensionaha.119.13445 (no long-term class difference in falls/syncope)
json.safe_reframing: Orthostatic dizziness is real and linked to falls; say 'stand up slowly, report dizziness', not 'this pill will make you hit the floor'.

json.claim: '9 popular medications that can trigger RAPID dementia' / 'medications that cause dementia'
json.source: AGS Beers Criteria (anticholinergic burden -> cognitive decline, delirium, falls) https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/24946-beers-criteria
json.safe_reframing: 'Medicines on the Beers list that can affect memory in older adults - review them with your pharmacist' (drop 'rapid dementia').

json.claim: Exercise/balance training prevents falls
json.source: Cochrane review Sherrington 2019 https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD012424.pub2/full (exercise reduces rate of falls 23%, high certainty); CDC falls facts https://www.cdc.gov/falls/data-research/facts-stats/index.html
json.safe_reframing: Keep. Frame a single walking cue as one part of balance training, not a life-saving guarantee.

json.claim: 'One SIMPLE change to how you walk could save your life after 70'
json.source: Cochrane 2019 supports multi-component exercise programs, not one gait cue
json.safe_reframing: 'The walking habit physical therapists check first - and the balance exercises proven to cut falls'.

json.claim: 'The ONLY 6 exercises you need to relieve neuropathy in feet & legs'
json.source: PMC meta-analysis exercise in DPN https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10065320/ (balance improved; no clear effect on fall risk); BMC Neuroscience RCT https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12868-024-00924-6
json.safe_reframing: 'Seated exercises that can improve balance and symptom comfort with neuropathy' - drop 'only' and 'relieve' as a cure promise.

json.claim: 'The REAL reason you wake up to pee at night - it's not your bladder'
json.source: Sleep Foundation nocturia https://www.sleepfoundation.org/physical-health/nocturia-or-frequent-unrination-night (nocturnal polyuria may be the most common cause; evening fluid/caffeine limits advised)
json.source_type: Health information publisher citing clinical literature
json.safe_reframing: 'Often it's how much urine your body makes at night, not bladder size - and when to get checked (prostate, diabetes, heart, sleep apnea)'.

json.claim: Seniors need to bathe only 2-3 times per week; short warm showers
json.source: American Academy of Dermatology guidance as reported by StudyFinds https://studyfinds.com/how-often-should-seniors-shower-experts-say-daily-too-much/ and Medical News Today https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/324682 (secondary sources)
json.safe_reframing: 'Most older adults don't need a full bath daily - dry skin is the reason; daily washing of key areas still matters'.

json.claim: 'Stanford study: wall-assisted mini squat cut knee pain 64% in 137 adults aged 70-88'; 'Johns Hopkins 2022, 1,100 adults'
json.source: Search for the cited Stanford trial found no matching study (closest: Saudi Arabia isometric wall-squat RCT https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41381113/)
json.safe_reframing: Never cite a study that cannot be linked. Use Cochrane/RCT sources with URLs in the description.

json.claim: 'Add THIS to your coffee - stem cells reactivate, cancer starves, fat burns'
json.appears_in: 1KEvPjIZVsU (Elias 1.3K); HWP 'This ONE Food Regrows Stem Cells & STARVES Cancer'
json.source: No supporting human evidence found; extraordinary cancer claim
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE.

json.claim: 'World's No.1 heart surgeon: Walking won't save you / STOP WALKING'
json.source: CDC falls/physical-activity guidance; Cochrane 2019 (walking-inclusive exercise programs)
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE. Acceptable contrarian: 'walking alone may not build leg strength - add these strength moves' (TopHealthTips 800K shows the accurate version works).

json.claim: 'Never eat this fish - it shortens your life' (salmon shown)
json.source: American Heart Association fish twice weekly https://www.heart.org/en/news/2018/05/25/eating-fish-twice-a-week-reduces-heart-stroke-risk
json.safe_reframing: 'Which fish to limit (high-mercury) vs which to eat twice a week' - never show salmon as the villain.

json.claim: Supplement-drug interactions (e.g., turmeric with statins/BP tablets)
json.source: Clove-warfarin interaction evidence (MV-06) as model; turmeric-specific source not fetched this session
json.safe_reframing: 'Supplements to check with your pharmacist if you take blood thinners, statins or BP tablets'.

json.claim: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy pill) availability for older adults
json.source: Novo Nordisk FDA approval announcement (Dec 22, 2025) https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=916472 ; AJMC https://www.ajmc.com/view/fda-approves-oral-semaglutide-as-first-glp-1-pill-for-weight-loss
json.source_type: Manufacturer + trade press on FDA action
json.safe_reframing: Only factual status + 'questions to ask your doctor'; no dosing advice.

json.claim: Clove + coffee: 'What happens 10 minutes later' / script: 'in the first 15 minutes... energy without the jitters... eugenol relaxes blood vessels'
json.source: Banner Health clove water review https://www.bannerhealth.com/healthcareblog/advise-me/the-benefits-and-risks-of-drinking-clove-water ; Noom evidence summary https://www.noom.com/blog/weight-management/clove-water-for-weight-loss/ (evidence is from concentrated extracts/preliminary studies, not culinary clove water)
json.safe_reframing: No study shows a 10- or 15-minute effect. Safe: 'What cloves actually contain, what the research on concentrated extracts shows, and why a cup of clove coffee is flavour, not medicine'. Note title (10 min) and script (15 min) disagree.

json.claim: 'Eugenol is a natural anti-inflammatory that works stronger than ibuprofen in some studies'
json.source: No human trial at culinary dose located this session; evidence summaries above describe lab/extract studies only
json.safe_reframing: Do not compare a spice to a drug. Say 'lab studies suggest eugenol has anti-inflammatory activity; that has not been shown in people drinking clove coffee'.

json.claim: Clove coffee: 'within 3 days blood sugar stabilizes... eugenol improves insulin receptor sensitivity'; 'within 1 month... cleaner liver'
json.source: Same evidence summaries (scarce human data)
json.safe_reframing: Remove dated benefit ladders. Blood-sugar claims require diabetes-care framing and a clinician referral.

json.claim: Clove/eugenol + blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin): talk to a doctor first
json.appears_in: KPigGh9_gbU transcript (contraindication segment); 1xLJ3ZsDt38 (SHH 'STOP using cloves with these medications')
json.source: Drugs.com clove-warfarin interaction https://www.drugs.com/drug-interactions/clove-with-warfarin-2548-0-2311-0.html ; PubMed alternative therapies & warfarin https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10902065/
json.safe_reframing: Keep: 'large amounts of clove, especially oil or extracts, may add to bleeding risk with blood thinners - ask your pharmacist'.

json.claim: 'Up to 12 kg of waste inside your body' / '5 KG of stool out in 1 hour' / 'Flush 10 lbs in 1 min' / '1 cup = total cleanse'

json.safe_reframing: 'Constipation after 60: what actually helps (fiber, fluids, movement, medication review) and why colon cleanses are not recommended'.

json.claim: 'This fruit repairs eyes overnight - cataracts' (thumbnail)
json.source: American Academy of Ophthalmology nutrition review https://www.aao.org/eyenet/article/nutrition-in-fight-against-eye-disease ; NEI AREDS/AREDS2 https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/clinical-trials/age-related-eye-disease-studies-aredsareds2/about-areds-and-areds2 (AREDS supplements had no effect on cataract)
json.safe_reframing: 'Foods linked with eye health (leafy greens: lutein/zeaxanthin) - and what diet cannot do for cataracts'.

json.claim: 'This 1 vegetable heals dead kidneys (lower creatinine fast)' / 'lower creatinine overnight'
json.appears_in: Thumbnail #95 (Okoro), #63 (Ares); GT-14 rising 'how to lower creatinine overnight'
json.source: National Kidney Foundation creatinine https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/creatinine ; American Kidney Fund superfood trap https://www.kidneyfund.org/article/avoid-superfood-trap-tips-improve-your-creatinine-and-egfr
json.safe_reframing: 'What your creatinine number means, why no food heals kidneys overnight, and what actually protects kidney function (BP, sugar control, medication review)'.

json.claim: 'This sleeping position increases STROKE risk overnight'
json.source: American Heart Association 'Can sleep position affect your heart and brain health?' https://www.heart.org/en/news/2025/01/24/can-sleep-position-affect-your-heart-and-brain-health
json.safe_reframing: 'Back-sleeping can worsen sleep apnea - and untreated sleep apnea raises stroke risk'. No evidence that position alone causes stroke in healthy people.

json.claim: 'The most dangerous time to take blood pressure medication' / 'NEVER take BP pills at this time'
json.source: TIME trial, Lancet 2022 https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(22)01786-X/fulltext (evening vs morning: no difference in major CV outcomes; take at a convenient consistent time)
json.safe_reframing: 'Morning or night for BP pills? The 21,000-person TIME trial found no difference - consistency and side-effect timing matter more'.

json.claim: 'One of them could drop your blood pressure so fast you'll hit the floor before you reach the bathroom'
json.source: JAMDA meta-analysis orthostatic hypotension and falls https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(18)30635-2/abstract ; AHA Hypertension class-effects study https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/hypertensionaha.119.13445 (no long-term class difference in falls/syncope)
json.safe_reframing: Orthostatic dizziness is real and linked to falls; say 'stand up slowly, report dizziness', not 'this pill will make you hit the floor'.

json.claim: '9 popular medications that can trigger RAPID dementia' / 'medications that cause dementia'
json.source: AGS Beers Criteria (anticholinergic burden -> cognitive decline, delirium, falls) https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/24946-beers-criteria
json.safe_reframing: 'Medicines on the Beers list that can affect memory in older adults - review them with your pharmacist' (drop 'rapid dementia').

json.claim: Exercise/balance training prevents falls
json.source: Cochrane review Sherrington 2019 https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD012424.pub2/full (exercise reduces rate of falls 23%, high certainty); CDC falls facts https://www.cdc.gov/falls/data-research/facts-stats/index.html
json.safe_reframing: Keep. Frame a single walking cue as one part of balance training, not a life-saving guarantee.

json.claim: 'One SIMPLE change to how you walk could save your life after 70'
json.source: Cochrane 2019 supports multi-component exercise programs, not one gait cue
json.safe_reframing: 'The walking habit physical therapists check first - and the balance exercises proven to cut falls'.

json.claim: 'The ONLY 6 exercises you need to relieve neuropathy in feet & legs'
json.source: PMC meta-analysis exercise in DPN https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10065320/ (balance improved; no clear effect on fall risk); BMC Neuroscience RCT https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12868-024-00924-6
json.safe_reframing: 'Seated exercises that can improve balance and symptom comfort with neuropathy' - drop 'only' and 'relieve' as a cure promise.

json.claim: 'The REAL reason you wake up to pee at night - it's not your bladder'
json.source: Sleep Foundation nocturia https://www.sleepfoundation.org/physical-health/nocturia-or-frequent-unrination-night (nocturnal polyuria may be the most common cause; evening fluid/caffeine limits advised)
json.source_type: Health information publisher citing clinical literature
json.safe_reframing: 'Often it's how much urine your body makes at night, not bladder size - and when to get checked (prostate, diabetes, heart, sleep apnea)'.

json.claim: Seniors need to bathe only 2-3 times per week; short warm showers
json.source: American Academy of Dermatology guidance as reported by StudyFinds https://studyfinds.com/how-often-should-seniors-shower-experts-say-daily-too-much/ and Medical News Today https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/324682 (secondary sources)
json.safe_reframing: 'Most older adults don't need a full bath daily - dry skin is the reason; daily washing of key areas still matters'.

json.claim: 'Stanford study: wall-assisted mini squat cut knee pain 64% in 137 adults aged 70-88'; 'Johns Hopkins 2022, 1,100 adults'
json.source: Search for the cited Stanford trial found no matching study (closest: Saudi Arabia isometric wall-squat RCT https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41381113/)
json.safe_reframing: Never cite a study that cannot be linked. Use Cochrane/RCT sources with URLs in the description.

json.claim: 'Add THIS to your coffee - stem cells reactivate, cancer starves, fat burns'
json.appears_in: 1KEvPjIZVsU (Elias 1.3K); HWP 'This ONE Food Regrows Stem Cells & STARVES Cancer'
json.source: No supporting human evidence found; extraordinary cancer claim
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE.

json.claim: 'World's No.1 heart surgeon: Walking won't save you / STOP WALKING'
json.source: CDC falls/physical-activity guidance; Cochrane 2019 (walking-inclusive exercise programs)
json.safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE. Acceptable contrarian: 'walking alone may not build leg strength - add these strength moves' (TopHealthTips 800K shows the accurate version works).

json.claim: 'Never eat this fish - it shortens your life' (salmon shown)
json.source: American Heart Association fish twice weekly https://www.heart.org/en/news/2018/05/25/eating-fish-twice-a-week-reduces-heart-stroke-risk
json.safe_reframing: 'Which fish to limit (high-mercury) vs which to eat twice a week' - never show salmon as the villain.

json.claim: Supplement-drug interactions (e.g., turmeric with statins/BP tablets)
json.source: Clove-warfarin interaction evidence (MV-06) as model; turmeric-specific source not fetched this session
json.safe_reframing: 'Supplements to check with your pharmacist if you take blood thinners, statins or BP tablets'.

json.claim: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy pill) availability for older adults
json.source: Novo Nordisk FDA approval announcement (Dec 22, 2025) https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=916472 ; AJMC https://www.ajmc.com/view/fda-approves-oral-semaglutide-as-first-glp-1-pill-for-weight-loss
